dataflow.summary: The archive supplies an entry name. The extractor uses that name to select the file it writes.

reachability.summary: The caller must be able to supply an archive for extraction. The service account must have write access to the destination.

confidence.rationale: The destination passed to the file writer is visible in the reviewed code.

preventiveControls: Route all archive extraction through one helper that normalizes and validates destination paths.
findings.remediation: Normalize destinations and reject entries that escape the extraction root.
remediationTests: Assert that extracting an archive entry named `../escape.txt` fails without writing outside the extraction root.

severity.changeConditions: A filesystem policy that confines writes to a disposable import directory would limit the impact.
severity.rationale: The caller can alter files outside the import area with the permissions of the extraction service.

findings.summary: Archive extraction can overwrite files outside the directory chosen for the import.
findings.title: Unsafe archive extraction can escape the output directory

validation.summary: The extractor combines the output directory with the entry name and passes the resulting path to the writer. It never checks that the destination stays inside the output directory.
